questions.question: What is the count of singers?
List the name of singers in ascending order of net worth.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions ASC

questions.question: What are the names of singers ordered by ascending net worth?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions ASC

questions.question: What are the names of the singers whose birth years are either 1948 or 1949?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Birth_Year  =  1948 OR Birth_Year  =  1949

questions.question: Show different citizenship of singers and the number of singers of each citizenship.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Citizenship ,  COUNT(*) FROM singer GROUP BY Citizenship

questions.question: For each citizenship, what is the maximum net worth?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Citizenship ,  max(Net_Worth_Millions) FROM singer GROUP BY Citizenship

questions.question: Show the names of singers that have more than one song.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1

questions.question: Show the names of singers and the total sales of their songs.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  sum(T2.Sales) FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name

questions.question: List the name of singers that do not have any song.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Singer_ID NOT IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM song)

questions.question: What are the citizenships that are shared by singers with a birth year before 1945 and after 1955?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Citizenship FROM singer WHERE Birth_Year  <  1945 INTERSECT SELECT Citizenship FROM singer WHERE Birth_Year  >  1955
